SHANGHAI TIMES WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 1, 1922.

A

CANTON BOMB
OUTRAGE

Germans Disown Alien
Under Arrest

Several arrests have been
made since the night of October
19 when a bomb outrage was
committed, says the "Canton
Times." Among the arrested
was Dr. M. de Colbert, a German
subject now serving as a physician
in the Min Kuo or Republic
Hospital. De Colbert was taken
into custody with two other
members of the hospital staff.
Others arrested included Leong
Wah Hing, Treasurer of the
Chung Hua Dramatic Club.
Six bombs were thrown inside
the city and along the Bund.
The building occupied by the
"Morning Bell Daily News" col-
lapsed as a result of an explo-
sion causing surrounding shops
to fall at the same time, killing
one man and two girls, serious-
ly wounding nine, and slightly
injuring many. A young man
dressed in European style, ac-
companied by a boy, committed
the outrage and escaped.
Other outrages took place at
the Oriental Hotel, the Western
Hotel, and the Hotel Asia, all
along the Bund. In almost
every incident, a young woman
registered herself as Chu Chun-
shi, took a room and then left
soon before the explosion.
She carried only a small bag with
her. The woman was about 25
years old. No serious damage
was done to the hotels One
which exploded at Sing Kee, 35,
the Bund, wounded four, while
another bomb near East Bridge
injured a boat woman and a girl
When interviewed, Dr. de Col-
bert said that he was a German
and was in the employment of
the Min Kuo Hospital as a re-
sidential physician. He said that
his family consisted of a wife
and three children and they are
still in the Hospital as residents.
For a time Dr. de Colbert was
with the Red Cross Corps of the
Northern Expeditionary Army. He
has been committed to the Head-
quarters of the Cantonese Army
for trial.
The Germans in Canton would
not admit that the nationality of
de Colbert is German. They as-
serted that when he was in Sam-
shui doing Red Cross work for
the army, he carried an American
flag.
Dr. Lew Yuk-lia, Commissioner
for Foreign Affairs at Canton, is
looking into the matter, trying to
find out some of the past record
of this man.

《字林西报》，1922年11月1日，星期三。

A

广州炸弹
暴行

德国人否认被捕外籍人士为本国公民

据《广州时报》称，自10月19日晚发生炸弹暴行以来，已有多人被捕。被捕者中包括M. de Colbert博士，其为德国籍人士，目前在民国医院（Min Kuo or Republic Hospital）担任医师。De Colbert与医院另外两名职员一同被拘留。其他被捕者包括中华戏剧社司库梁华兴（Leong Wah Hing，音译）。
六枚炸弹被投掷于城内及沿外滩一带。“晨钟日报”（Morning Bell Daily News）馆舍因爆炸而倒塌，导致周围店铺同时坍塌，造成一男两女死亡，九人重伤，多人轻伤。一名身着欧式服装的青年男子在一名男孩陪同下实施了暴行并逃脱。
其他暴行发生在沿外滩的东方饭店（Oriental Hotel）、西方饭店（Western Hotel）和亚洲饭店（Hotel Asia）。在几乎每一起事件中，均有一名年轻女子以朱春氏（Chu Chun-shi，音译）之名登记入住，随后在爆炸发生前不久离开。她仅随身携带一个小包。该女子约25岁。各家饭店未遭受严重破坏。一枚在外滩35号新记（Sing Kee，音译）爆炸的炸弹致四人受伤，另一枚在东桥附近爆炸的炸弹致一名船妇和一名女孩受伤。
在接受问询时，de Colbert博士称其为德国人，受雇于民国医院担任驻院医师。他说其家庭成员包括妻子和三个孩子，他们仍作为住客留在医院内。De Colbert博士曾一度在北伐军红十字会服务队服役。他已被移交粤军司令部受审。
在广州的德国人不愿承认de Colbert的国籍为德国。他们声称，当他在三水为军队从事红十字会工作时，曾携带美国国旗。
广州外交委员刘玉麟（Lew Yuk-lia，音译）正在调查此事，试图查明此人的部分过往记录。

THE HONGKONG TELEGRAPH. MONDAY. OCTOBER 23. 1922.

BOMBS IN CANTON.
Alleged Russian Anarchist Arrested.
DEALINGS WITH SUN YAT-SEN.
(“Telegraph” Special).
Quite a sensation has been caused in Canton during the past two or three days by a series of bomb explosions, a brief account of which we gave in our Saturday’s issue. A Telegraph representative, who journeyed to Canton over the week-end to make further enquiries, was fortunate enough to have an interview with General Chan Wing-son, who has been responsible for a number of arrests in connection with the outrages. Among the arrested men is a European, who has claimed to be first an American, then a Frenchman and German, but who, from books and documents found in his possession, is thought a Russian.
General Chan Wing-son, in telling the story, said there had been six bomb outrages, one being in Room No. 7 of the Oriental Hotel, one being on the third floor of the Hotel Asia (which damaged four rooms), one being near the bridge on the East Bund, one at a newspaper office and two others in the City. A number of people had been killed and great excitement had been caused. Suspicion had fallen on certain men and some arrests had been made, but the most interesting arrest was that of a Doctor at the Mun Kwok Hospital (Republic Hospital) in Fu Tung Street.
“The man has been in Canton for some time,” said General Chan. “He was always mixed up with the Red Cross and at one time we suspected him of being a spy in our lines and carrying messages to Sun Yat-sen. That was during the recent trouble. When arrested, he said that he belonged to the Active Service Red Cross, Kwangtung Army, and, when asked who appointed him, replied that Mr. Tsze Ying-pak, M.P. had done so. There had been reports about him for some time, and the American Consul had brought the case to the notice of the authorities some time ago. The man’s name is Dr. Maxmillar de Colbert, and he stays at the Hospital where he was arrested, with his wife and three children. As a matter of fact, some of my detectives have been to the Hospital as patients, and one of them was taken into the man’s confidence and spoken to about bomb-throwing, being told how many paces to throw a bomb and how to lie flat down immediately.”
Telling of the arrest, General Chan said:—“I was at a dinner on Thursday night, when certain information was brought to me which decided me to make the man’s arrest. I took a party of men and we surrounded the hospital. We arrested the man and we then searched the place, but first of all we found nothing. In his office, I searched the drawers and found a lot of correspondence in Chinese which had reference to Sun Yat-sen. On the back of one of the letters the following in French was written:—‘Si Docteur Sun viendra a Canton—notre Anarchist Federation sera tres forte.’ (If Dr. Sun returns to Canton our Anarchist Federation will be very strong). Among the men arrested was a Chinese named Chan, who is de Colbert’s secretary and who was formerly private secretary to Tsze Ying-pak. In one of the drawers we found some revolver cartridges but we could not find any revolver. When asked about the revolver, de Colbert got excited and said ‘If I had it, I would shoot you.’ I told him to sit down and keep quiet. We searched the place further and under a couch we found these two bombs.” (General Chan then showed the interviewer two cast iron cylinders, fitted with screw-on tops and fuse holes. Except for a quantity of small shot, the cylinders were empty).
Proceeding, General Chan said:—“We also found a strong iron box with a screw on top, and a fuse hole, which has the appearance of being made for the purpose of putting under a wall.

《香港电讯报》，1922年10月23日，星期一。

广州炸弹案。
涉嫌俄国无政府主义者被捕。
与孙中山之交往。
（“电讯报”特约稿）。
过去两三天内，一系列炸弹爆炸事件在广州引起极大轰动，本报周六版曾简要报道。一位电讯报记者上周末前往广州作进一步调查，有幸采访了陈永善（Chan Wing-son，音译）将军，该将军负责处理与这些暴行有关的多起逮捕行动。被捕者中有一名欧洲人，他先自称是美国人，后又称是法国人和德国人，但根据从其身上搜出的书籍和文件，人们认为他是俄国人。
陈永善将军在讲述案情时表示，共发生了六起炸弹暴行，其中一起发生在东方饭店7号房间，一起发生在亚洲饭店三楼（损坏了四个房间），一起发生在东外滩桥梁附近，一起发生在一家报社办公室，另外两起发生在城内。多人丧生，引起了巨大恐慌。怀疑对象指向某些人，并已实施了一些逮捕，但最引人注目的逮捕行动是针对福通街（Fu Tung Street，音译）民国医院（Republic Hospital）的一名医生。
“此人在广州已有一段时间，”陈将军说。“他总是与红十字会混在一起，有一段时间我们怀疑他是我方战线内的间谍，向孙中山传递消息。那是在最近的动荡期间。被捕时，他说他属于粤军现役红十字会，当问及是谁任命他时，他回答说是议员资英伯（Tsze Ying-pak，音译）任命的。关于他的报告已有一段时间，美国领事此前也已将此案提请当局注意。此人名为马克西米拉·德·科尔伯特（Maxmillar de Colbert）博士，他与妻子和三个孩子住在他被捕的医院里。事实上，我的一些侦探曾以病人身份去过该医院，其中一人取得了此人的信任，并与他谈论了投掷炸弹的事宜，被告知投掷炸弹需走多少步以及随后如何立即趴下。”
谈及逮捕过程，陈将军说：“周四晚上我正在参加晚宴，当时有人向我提供了一些情报，使我决定逮捕此人。我带领一队人马包围了医院。我们逮捕了此人，然后搜查了该处，但起初一无所获。在他的办公室里，我搜查了抽屉，发现了许多涉及孙中山的中文信件。在其中一封信的背面用法文写着：‘Si Docteur Sun viendra a Canton—notre Anarchist Federation sera tres forte.’（如果孙博士回到广州，我们的无政府主义联合会将非常强大。）被捕者中有一名姓陈的中国人，他是de Colbert的秘书，曾任资英伯的私人秘书。在一个抽屉里我们发现了一些左轮手枪子弹，但未找到左轮手枪。当问及左轮手枪时，de Colbert变得激动起来，说‘如果我有枪，我会毙了你。’我让他坐下并保持安静。我们进一步搜查该处，在沙发下发现了这两枚炸弹。”（陈将军随后向记者展示了两只铸铁圆筒，配有螺旋盖和引信孔。除少量小弹丸外，圆筒内是空的）。
陈将军接着说：“我们还发现了一个坚固的铁盒，顶部有螺旋盖和引信孔，看起来像是为了放置在墙下而制造的。

We found drills, files, and a whole lot of tools. We found no explosives, but, of course, the man's dispensary was stocked with the usual chemicals and drugs from which explosives could soon be made. Some of the correspondence we found is very important. Afterwards, I questioned the man. He gave his age as 48 and said he was a German. He came to China some months ago by way of Moscow, Siberia and Vladivostok. He stayed in Moscow eight months. He applied for American papers in Vladivostok, because he had lived in Wisconsin. His application was refused and he later came on to Shanghai and down to Canton.
"I showed him the letters we had found and pointed out the writing in French; and he said:—"Yes, I am an Anarchist. But there are four kinds of anarchists, and I am one of the Tolstoi type, doing educational work' When asked when he had last seen Sun Yat-sen, he said he saw him on the day he left his anchorage at Whampoa and steamed up to Canton together. He saw Sun three times together. 'because he had plans.' I asked him what he meant and he replied that they are educational and that he was seeking to establish a University and a Sanitorium. He admitted that he had been to Hainan for educational purposes. The seized correspondence showed that the man had been to Hainan and the words 'Bureau' and 'Federation' occur in the letters. When questioned about the bombs, the man said he did not know anything about them. He said that his little boy had picked them up in the street, when playing near the Provincial Treasury and that they had been used as door weights. He said he had lost his revolver and denied that

he was mixed up with any political affairs. He added that at one time the late Dr. Wu Ting-fang had been helping him in his educational work but now that Dr. Wu had died he had had to go to Sun. The majority of his papers and books are Russian; there are photographs obviously taken in Russia and the man speaks Russian, English, German and French."
General Chan added that the man was still being detained and would probably be sent to General Chan King-ming for a further examination. The German Consul—at least the German representative in Canton who is seeking recognition as a Consul—has refused to have anything to do with the man, and the authorities were considering the question of deporting him. The Secretary would be tried by Court Martial. The authorities were hoping to get to the bottom of the outrages, for it was known that certain prominent men in Canton had been threatened.
It is stated that an examination of the arrested man's clinical books shows that he had practised in Neshkoro, New Lisbon and Red Granite, in Wisconsin, during the years 1917, 1918 and 1919. There are many gaps in the records, which, incidentally, show that he had had few patients during these three years. The man's friends claim that he served in the American Red Cross in Belgium during the war. His wife is said to be a German, and there are three children, a boy aged eleven and two girls aged nine and seven respectively.
In consequence of the bomb explosions, the value of the paper money fell on Saturday from 66 cents per dollar to 63 cents. These is a little public uneasiness, but the authorities hope speedily to restore confidence.

我们发现了钻头、锉刀和大量工具。我们没有发现炸药，当然，此人的药房备有通常的化学药品和药物，从中可以很快制造出炸药。我们发现的一些信件非常重要。之后，我审问了此人。他称自己48岁，是德国人。他几个月前经莫斯科、西伯利亚和符拉迪沃斯托克来到中国。他在莫斯科停留了八个月。他在符拉迪沃斯托克申请美国证件，因为他曾在威斯康星州居住。他的申请被拒绝，随后他来到上海，再南下广州。
“我向他展示了我们发现的信件，并指出了法文笔迹；他说：‘是的，我是无政府主义者。但无政府主义者有四种，我是托尔斯泰型的，从事教育工作’。当问及他最后一次见到孙中山是什么时候，他说是在孙中山离开黄埔锚地并一同乘船溯江而上至广州的那天见到的。他总共见过孙中山三次，‘因为他有计划’。我问他是什么意思，他回答说这些计划是教育性质的，他正寻求建立一所大学和一个疗养院。他承认曾出于教育目的去过海南。查获的信件显示此人曾去过海南，信中出现了‘局’（Bureau）和‘联合会’（Federation）等字样。当问及炸弹时，此人称对此一无所知。他说他的小男孩在省财政厅附近玩耍时在街上捡到了它们，并被用作门挡。他说他的左轮手枪丢了，并否认
卷入任何政治事务。他补充说，已故的伍廷芳博士曾一度帮助他的教育工作，但现在伍博士去世，他不得不去找孙中山。他的大部分文件和书籍是俄文的；有一些显然是在俄罗斯拍摄的照片，且此人会说俄语、英语、德语和法语。”
陈将军补充说，此人仍被拘留，可能会被送交陈炯明（Chan King-ming，音译）将军作进一步审查。德国领事——至少是那位正在广州寻求被承认为领事的德国代表——已拒绝与此人有任何瓜葛，当局正在考虑将其驱逐出境。其秘书将由军事法庭审判。当局希望彻底查清这些暴行的底细，因为据悉广州某些知名人士曾受到威胁。
据说，对被捕者的病历进行检查显示，他在1917、1918和1919年间曾在威斯康星州的Neshkoro、New Lisbon和Red Granite行医。记录中有许多空白，顺便指出，这些记录显示他在这三年间病人很少。此人的朋友声称他在战争期间曾在比利时的美国红十字会服役。据说其妻子是德国人，有三个孩子，一个11岁的男孩和两个分别为9岁和7岁的女孩。
由于炸弹爆炸，纸币价值在周六从每元66美分跌至63美分。公众略有不安，但当局希望能迅速恢复信心。

The last five months have seen a decided advance
of Bolshevism in China despite the set-off experienced
at Canton where, owing to the action of CHEN CHIUNG MING,
open activity has been deemed highly unprofitable by the
local Bolsheviks and Anarchists. Not only has Bolshevism
increased in China but it has also advanced at the expense
of Anarchism and many Anarchists who were formerly opposed
to Bolshevism are becoming convinced that Bolshevism is,
at the present - time, the far more active force of the
two and are joining the Bolsheviks in the hope that, per-
haps ultimately, Anarchism may succeed Bolshevism.

This increased activity has been principally
due to the renewed exertions of Russian Bolsheviks and to
the activity of the Kuomintang, which Society seems in-
tent on embracing all the Revolutionary Societies of
China.

One effect of the altered situation in Canton
has been the driving away from that city of many leavers
who now cluster round SUN YAT SEN at Shanghai.

One of the most sinister signs of this increased
activity is to be found in the large number of strikes
which have broken out all over China and which may be
directly connected with the May Day celebrations at Can-
ton and the activities of certain well-known Chinese
workers.

In order to simplify this report it is proposed
to divide it into three sections:-
(1) Russian Bolshevism,
(2) Anarchism and Communism in China
(3) Labour troubles.

在过去的五个月里，尽管在广州遭遇了挫折——由于陈炯明（CHEN CHIUNG MING）的行动，当地布尔什维克和无政府主义者认为公开活动极无利可图——但布尔什维主义在中国仍取得了显著进展。布尔什维主义不仅在中国日益壮大，而且是以牺牲无政府主义为代价取得进展的；许多以前反对布尔什维主义的无政府主义者正逐渐确信，布尔什维主义是目前两者中更为活跃的力量，并加入布尔什维克行列，希望或许最终无政府主义能取代布尔什维主义。

这种活动的增加主要归因于俄国布尔什维克的重新努力，以及国民党的活动；该党似乎有意囊括中国所有的革命团体。

广州局势变化的一个影响是，许多离开者被驱离该市，目前他们聚集在上海的孙中山（SUN YAT SEN）周围。

这种活动加剧的最不祥迹象之一，是中国各地爆发的大量罢工，这些罢工可能与广州的五一庆祝活动以及某些知名中国工人的活动直接相关。

为简化本报告，拟将其分为三个部分：
(1) 俄国布尔什维主义，
(2) 中国的无政府主义和共产主义
(3) 劳工纠纷。

(1) RUSSIAN BOLSHEVISM.- The rendition of Vladivos-
tock gave a great fillip to Russian Bolshevik activities
in China, particularly in Shanghai which at present is
certainly the headquarters of Bolshevism in China and
which, owing to the change of administration in Canton,
has become more prominent than ever. As soon as Vladivos-
tock was recovered by the "Reds" a change was noticeable
in their method of propaganda. The Bolshevik paper called
"Shanghai Life", which had been principally devoted to
propaganda regarding Vladivostock and the Japanese, and
which is said to be an organ of the Chita Government, no
longer is issued and in its place an organ of a similar
type called the "New Shanghai Life" is issued which strong-
ly advocates the policy of the Third International and
is controlled from Moscow. In addition to this paper a
weekly paper entitled "New Russia", which is very well
brought out and published in English, has also been re-
gularly issued and is stated to be financed by JOFFE who
supplies through his staff the whole of its contents. It
is also said that the "New Shanghai Life" will have a
Chinese edition, or at any rate propaganda extracts from
it will be published in Chinese.

✓ NOVITSKY, the old editor of the "Shanghai Life"
is said to be leaving for Moscow to receive fresh instruc-

an important local Bolshevik who is said to have been a

(1) 俄国布尔什维主义。——符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock，即海参崴）的易手极大地刺激了俄国布尔什维克在中国的活动，尤其是在上海；上海目前无疑是中国布尔什维主义的大本营，且由于广州行政当局的变化，其地位比以往任何时候都更加突出。“红军”收复符拉迪沃斯托克后，其宣传方法发生了明显变化。名为《上海生活》（Shanghai Life）的布尔什维克报纸此前主要致力于有关符拉迪沃斯托克和日本人的宣传，据称是赤塔（Chita）政府的机关报，现已停刊；取而代之的是一份名为《新上海生活》（New Shanghai Life）的同类机关报，该报强烈倡导第三国际的政策，并由莫斯科控制。除该报外，还定期发行一份英文周报，题为《新俄罗斯》（New Russia），编排精良，据称由越飞（JOFFE）资助，其全部内容均由越飞的工作人员提供。另有说法称，《新上海生活》将出版中文版，或者至少会刊登其中文宣传摘录。

✓ 《上海生活》的前任编辑诺维茨基（NOVITSKY）据称将前往莫斯科接受新指示，在他缺席期间，斯列什科（SLESHKO）将负责主持工作。

“红军”进入符拉迪沃斯托克一事在当地布尔什维克中引起了极大欢欣，并在《新上海生活》报社办公室举行了一次秘密会议；除报社工作人员外，杰克·利泽罗维奇（JACK LIZEROVITCH）、芬克尔戈尔德（FINKELGOLD）和库罗布金（KUROBKIN，即 Korolkin 的正确姓名）也出席了会议。后者是一位重要的当地布尔什维克，据称曾是一名

well-known Russian Nihilist and an expert bomb maker.
KUROBKIN, in conversation, stated that he had previously
been a soldier in the Russian Army and had fought on the
side of the British as an aviator in Siberia. This he
says was a great mistake, but he had to do so from force
of circumstances. At present he is a whole-hearted Bolshe-
vik and very anti-British. KUROBKIN is stated to be a man
far above the average intelligence and to be well read.
In his opinion there will be a revolution in six or seven
years in China owing to the very successful progress being
made by the Third International. KUROBKIN is at present
trying to leave Shanghai for Australia.

FINKELGOLD, the Russian who went to Canton with
de Colbert, returned to Shanghai in October. He was very
bitter against deColbert whose conduct he says had greatly
exasperated certain of the local Chinese who declaring
that they had been deceived by him posted up all over
Canton leaflets exposing his character. DeColbert on his
arrival at Canton was sent by SUN YAT SEN to HSIEH YING-PO
but was quickly discovered to be a fraud and attempted to
get away from Canton but no Consul would give him a pass-
port. FINKELGOLD states that he has made enquiries from
Russia regarding DeColbert and learned that his real name
was MORDECAI GOLDBERG and that he came from a Russian Jew
family of Odessa. Whilst in Russia DeCOLBERT was suspected
by the Bolsheviks as an American agent and was imprisoned
for some time; this information is said to be contained in
a pamphlet officially issued by the Irkutsk Propaganda
Bureau. (There appears to be some ground for believing
that DeCOLBERT has in the past worked for the Americans
as he was sent from Vladivostock to Shanghai with a free
passage by the Vladivostock American Consul). DeCOLBERT

著名的俄国虚无主义者，也是制造炸弹的专家。库罗布金（KUROBKIN）在谈话中表示，他此前曾在俄国军队服役，并在西伯利亚作为飞行员站在英国一方作战。他说这是一个巨大的错误，但当时迫于形势不得不如此。目前他是一名全心全意的布尔什维克，且极度反英。据称，库罗布金的才智远高于常人，且博览群书。在他看来，鉴于第三国际取得的非常成功的进展，中国将在六七年內发生革命。库罗布金目前正试图离开上海前往澳大利亚。

与德科尔贝特（de Colbert）一同前往广州的俄国人芬克尔戈尔德（FINKELGOLD）于十月返回上海。他对德科尔贝特怀有强烈的怨恨，称其行为极大地激怒了一些当地中国人，这些人宣称受到他的欺骗，并在广州各处张贴传单揭露其为人。德科尔贝特抵达广州后，被孙中山派往谢英伯（HSIEH YING-PO），但很快就被发现是个骗子；他试图逃离广州，但没有一位领事愿意给他签发护照。芬克尔戈尔德表示，他已向俄国方面查询关于德科尔贝特的情况，获悉其真名为莫迪凯·戈德堡（MORDECAI GOLDBERG），来自敖德萨的一个俄国犹太家庭。在俄国期间，德科尔贝特被布尔什维克怀疑为美国代理人，并被监禁了一段时间；据说这一信息包含在伊尔库茨克宣传局正式发行的一本小册子中。（似乎有理由相信德科尔贝特过去曾为美国人工作，因为他是由符拉迪沃斯托克美国领事提供免费船票从符拉迪沃斯托克送往上海的）。德科尔贝特

is at present under arrest in Canton in connection with
the numerous bomb explosions which took place in that
city, and there is reason to believe that he paid a
flying visit to SUN YAT SEN at Shanghai shortly before
these explosions took place. It is more than probable
that deCOLBERT has been acting purely as an agent of SUN
YAT SEN. (The Consul General at Canton was informed regard-

some months before the latter was arrested).

There is, at present, a constant going and
coming of Bolsheviks between Shanghai and Vladivostock.
On the 15th of November, Leonidoff, a Plenipotentiary
of the Moscow Government and a member of the Third
International, left Shanghai for Vladivostock accompanied
by GVOSDAREV junior, another well-known Bolshevik agent
who has frequently been reported on by Vladivostock.
LEONIDOFF has still a house and wife in Shanghai at 151
Avenue Dubail. Whilst in Shanghai the pair were in
✓ close touch with Dr. FORTUNATOFF, the head of the local
"Cheka", and MOROSOFF, resident of the "Centrosoiuse".
LEONIDOFF and GVOSDAREV junior were accompanied to their
✓ ship by ALEXANDROFF, the Captain of the s.s. "Erivan" and
a prominent Bolshevik, and GVOSDAREV senior who has also
been reported to be one of the leaders of the local Bol-
shevik organization. GVOSDAREV is a particularly danger-
ous man and was formerly in the Bolshevik Military Intelli-
gence at Vladivostock. He is said to read and write
Chinese fluently and to be a valuable medium between the
local Russians and Chinese Bolsheviks.

Another Bolshevik leader who was present was
✓ RICHTERMAN who is Assistant to the head of Bolshevik
Intelligence Bureau in Shanghai which was formed last
year by ANGERSKY. In addition to the above Shanghai

目前因该市发生的多起炸弹爆炸事件而在广州被捕，且有理由相信，在这些爆炸发生前不久，他曾对上海的孙中山进行过短暂的访问。德科尔贝特极有可能纯粹是作为孙中山的代理人行事。（在德科尔贝特被捕前几个月，驻广州总领事已获知有关其为人及制造炸弹声誉的情况）。

目前，布尔什维克分子在上海和符拉迪沃斯托克之间往来频繁。11月15日，莫斯科政府全权代表、第三国际成员列昂尼多夫（Leonidoff）离开上海前往符拉迪沃斯托克，陪同他的是小格沃兹达列夫（GVOSDAREV junior），另一位著名的布尔什维克特工，符拉迪沃斯托克方面曾多次报告过他的情况。列昂尼多夫在上海杜拜路（Avenue Dubail）151号仍留有住所和妻子。在上海期间，这两人与当地“契卡”（Cheka）负责人福尔图纳托夫博士（Dr. FORTUNATOFF）以及“中央消费合作总社”（Centrosoiuse）居民莫罗索夫（MOROSOFF）保持密切联系。列昂尼多夫和小格沃兹达列夫由“埃里温”号（s.s. "Erivan"）船长、著名布尔什维克亚历山德罗夫（ALEXANDROFF），以及老格沃兹达列夫（GVOSDAREV senior）护送至船上；老格沃兹达列夫也被报告为当地布尔什维克组织的领导人之一。格沃兹达列夫是一个特别危险的人物，此前曾在符拉迪沃斯托克的布尔什维克军事情报部门任职。据称他能流利地读写中文，是当地俄国人与中国布尔什维克之间有价值的联络媒介。

出席的另一位布尔什维克领导人是里希特曼（RICHTERMAN），他是去年由安杰尔斯基（ANGERSKY）组建的上海布尔什维克情报局负责人的助理。除上述人员外，上海

was visited by two suspects who have undoubtedly strong
Bolshevik connections.
(1) E. GERSEN LEIBOVITZ.- This man who had fallen
under suspicion in India owing to his Bolshevik and Pro-
Turk sympathies, is said to be a British protected Palis-
tinian subject, though born in Petrograd. His presence
was detected in Shanghai shortly before he left for Hong-
Kong and arrangements were made to examine his papers at
that port. Nothing of any great interest was discovered,
but the fact that he had a note of the address 151 Avenue
Dubail and the name LIVEN (An important Bolshevik Jew in
Shanghai) show that his visit to Shanghai was by no means
an innocent one.
(2) Another visitor was JOHN A. BRAILSFORD regarding
whom a separate report is submitted. (q.v.)
In addition to the above, EROSHENKO, the blind
Russian Esperanto teacher, has recently returned to
Peking after a stay of three months in Moscow. The --
activities of this man will be dealt with in a separate
report on "Anarchism and Communism in Peking".
(2) ANARCHISM AND COMMUNISM IN CHINA - There has

whole of China, and it was doubtless this idea which led
the Kuomintang party in Shanghai to take up the proposal
strongly and to assert that the Kuomintang stands for the

called the DAH TUNG TANG SOCIETY recruited from persons
already members of the Kuomintang. The most active
organizers of this Society are MRS. HWANG HSING, HSIH YING-
PO, CHANG CHI TSAI AND WHANG MING. Its avowed object is

还接待了两名毫无疑问与布尔什维克有密切联系的嫌疑人。
(1) E. 格尔森·莱博维茨（E. GERSEN LEIBOVITZ）。——此人因具有布尔什维克和亲土耳其倾向而在印度受到怀疑，据称是受英国保护的巴勒斯坦籍臣民，尽管出生于彼得格勒。他在离开上海前往香港前夕，其在沪行踪被发现，当局已安排在该港口检查其文件。未发现任何极具价值的信息，但他持有杜拜路151号的地址纸条以及利文（LIVEN，上海一位重要的布尔什维克犹太人）的名字，这一事实表明他访问上海绝非无辜之举。
(2) 另一位访客是约翰·A·布雷尔斯福德（JOHN A. BRAILSFORD），关于此人另有一份报告提交。（参见上文）
此外，盲人俄语世界语教师爱罗先珂（EROSHENKO）在莫斯科停留三个月后，最近已返回北京。此人的活动将在另一份关于“北京的无政府主义和共产主义”的报告中予以处理。
(2) 中国的无政府主义和共产主义 —— 主要的无政府主义者和共产主义者中间流传着大量关于组建一个涵盖全中国的大型组织的言论，毫无疑问，正是这一想法促使上海的国民党强烈采纳该提议，并声称国民党支持无政府主义和共产主义团体的成员，同时还组建了一个名为“大同党”（DAH TUNG TANG SOCIETY）的内部秘密社团，其成员从已是国民党党员的人中招募。该社团最积极的组织者是黄兴夫人（MRS. HWANG HSING）、谢英伯（HSIH YING-PO）、张继（CHANG CHI TSAI）和王明（WHANG MING）。其公开目标是

page_data.en:

to assist all revolutionary parties in China, Japan, Korea,
India, Annam and Java, and at the present moment one of
its principal activities is the collecting of arms on
the Korean frontier for Korean insurgents. Many branches
have already been established in China, Annam and Java.
The well-known leader, CHEN DU HSIU, is still
busy and in July was fined heavily for disseminating
Communist literature in Shanghai. It is now reported
that he has joined the Kuomintang which shows undoubtedly
the value he places on that organization in assisting the
progress of Anarchism and Communism in China.
It is proposed to hold a convention of Anarchists
and Communists and about 35 of the leading Anarchists and
Communists met to discuss this proposition which was strong-
ly supported by the Kuomintang. The leaders of this move-
ment are WANG LIH SUN and U WAI TSUN who is said to be
a representative of the Canton Machinists' Union. Another
Chinese leader called SUI and a Formosan BAI are assisting
in the movement and TENG HSUN CH'I, a Chinese Doctor who
graduated from the Chiba Medical School in Japan, presided
at the meeting which was held to discuss this question.
One of the speakers at the meeting stated that the Anar-
chists and Communists of Japan and Korea were also forming
fresh Unions and hoped to bring them all into one Far
Eastern Association and to have a common meeting place at
which Labour and Communist literature would be available
for all members.
A prominent Korean Communist, J. S. KIM, is
still very enthusiastic regarding the support the Koreans
hope to receive from Russia. He is, however, by no means
sanguine that the movement is very strong in Korea itself.
According to KIM, the Third International has altered its

援助中国、日本、朝鲜、印度、安南和爪哇的所有革命政党，目前其主要活动之一是在朝鲜边境为朝鲜起义者收集武器。在中国、安南和爪哇已经建立了许多分支机构。
著名领袖陈独秀（CHEN DU HSIU）依然活跃，七月因在上海散布共产主义文献而被处以重罚。现据报告，他已加入国民党，这无疑表明他看重该组织在协助无政府主义和共产主义在中国进展方面的价值。
拟举行一次无政府主义者和共产主义者大会，约35名主要的无政府主义者和共产主义者开会讨论这一提议，该提议得到了国民党的强力支持。这一运动的领导人是王立孙（WANG LIH SUN）和吴伟尊（U WAI TSUN），据称后者是广州机器工会的代表。另一位姓隋（SUI）的中国领导人和一位姓白（BAI）的台湾人正在协助推动这一运动，主持会议讨论此问题的是邓勋祺（TENG HSUN CH'I，音译），一位毕业于日本千叶医学院的中国医生。会上的一位发言者表示，日本和朝鲜的无政府主义者和共产主义者也在组建新的工会，并希望将它们全部纳入一个远东协会，并设立一个共同的聚会场所，供所有成员获取劳工和共产主义文献。
一位著名的朝鲜共产主义者金始性（J. S. KIM，音译）对于朝鲜人希望从俄国获得的支持仍然充满热情。然而，他对于该运动在朝鲜本土是否强大并不乐观。据金氏称，第三国际已改变其

page_data.en:

previous policy which was very antagonistic to National-
ism, and is now making use of the various Nationalist
parties in India, Persia, Turkey and elsewhere to push
their own propaganda which is financially supported by
German and American Communists. The Third International
is said to be divided into three sections, the Near East
Section, the Middle East Section and the Far East Section.
According to MI, Mongolia is at present completely under
Soviet control and a number of local leaders who are anti-
Lamaistic are working with the "Reds", the idea of the
Soviet Government being to keep Mongolia as a buffer state
between China and Siberia.

A local Committee has been formed in Shanghai
by the Chinese and Koreans with the intention of calling
a conference of "The Toilers of the Far East". It is clear
that their action is being directed by the Third Interna-
tional. It has not yet been decided where this Conference
will be held, but Shanghai has been decided upon as by no
means a fit place for it.

CHANG HO CHI, the Chinese Communist, who was working
with the Irkutsk Propaganda Bureau, has recently been
visiting Paotingfu from which place he went on to see the
Christian General FUNG in Honan.

(3) LABOUR TROUBLE. - The past six months have seen a
large number of strikes all over China. In Shanghai itself
there have been a number of strikes. At Hanyang (near
Hankow) there were very serious strikes in the local iron
Works and the Arsenal. A strike broke out on the Peking-
Mukden Railway in which the demands of the workers con-
tained obvious Bolshevik sentiments, and in Tongshan there
was a very serious strike at the mines of the Kailan Mining
Association which also showed more than traces of Bolshevism

此前对民族主义持强烈敌对态度的政策，如今正利用印度、波斯、土耳其及其他各地的各种民族主义政党来推行其自身的宣传，该宣传在财政上得到德国和美国共产主义者的支持。据称，第三国际分为三个部门：近东部、中东部和远东部。据军情局（MI）称，蒙古目前完全处于苏维埃控制之下，一些反喇嘛教的当地领导人正与“赤色分子”合作，苏维埃政府的意图是将蒙古保持为中国与西伯利亚之间的缓冲国。

上海的中方和韩方人员已成立一个地方委员会，旨在召开一次“远东劳动者”会议。显然，他们的行动正受第三国际的指挥。此次会议的举办地点尚未确定，但上海已被认定绝非合适的举办地。

中国共产党员张浩池（CHANG HO CHI，音译），此前曾在伊尔库茨克宣传局工作，最近访问了保定府，并从那里前往河南去会见冯玉祥将军（Christian General FUNG）。

ALMANIS (L.R.U.L.) the wellknown book maker friend
of Dr. LILIT who was recently in Raton has now returned to
work there he is working in the Latvian Economic Society
store. ALMANIS in conversation stated that he was previous-
ly a soldier and had also gone in for aviation; he had fought
with the British army against the Bolsheviks in Siberia. This
action on his part he considers a great mistake but he had to
do so from force of circumstances. Previously he was not a
whole-hearted Bolshevist but now considers that Bolshevism
has come to stay in Latvia. In fact his whole conversation
shows that he is a fanatical follower of all that is most
extreme in Bolshevism.

ALMANIS further stated that in his opinion
there would be a revolution in six or seven years and the 3rd
International was making very successful progress in this
country. He gave very full details as to what he considered to be far
above the average intelligence and said it would read men probably
of poor family.

It is stated by certain Jews who are in close
touch with the Communist movement in Riga that de Albert
visited an address some 10 days before the bomb explosions
in Raton and after a private interview returned to Riga
immediately.

A local committee of Chinese and Koreans has been
formed to call a conference of the "Toilers of the Far East";
it seems that their action is being directed by the 3rd Inter-
national. It has not yet been decided where the conference
is to be held but Shanghai has been condemned as by no means
a fit place for it.

阿尔马尼斯进一步表示，他认为六七年之内会发生革命，第三国际在这个国家进展非常顺利。他提供了非常详尽的细节，他认为这些细节显示出远高于平均水平的智力，并称阅读这些内容的人可能出身贫寒。

据某些与里加共产主义运动密切联系的犹太人称，德·阿尔伯特（de Albert）在拉顿发生炸弹爆炸前约十天访问了一个地址，在进行私人会晤后立即返回里加。

袁是由霍多罗夫（HODOROFF）派往上海的，目的是为罗斯塔新闻社（Rosta News Agency）工作，并曾在霍多罗夫的办公室接受过布尔什维主义的训练。目前他借住在丁雅各（Y. A. DING，音译）处。这位年轻人非常崇拜霍多罗夫，称其控制着北京和天津的许多报纸。关于苏维埃宣传在中国的进展，他表示苏俄的影响力与日俱增，尤其是在南方，最近来自广州的报告令人非常满意。迄今为止，北方的督军们尚未对苏维埃事业表现出积极的同情，但在南方，许多领导人的倾向非常有利，特别是李烈钧（LI LIEH CHUN）。袁本人与苏维埃当局保持着定期通信，各地的学生都亲苏。

袁直到去年年初一直是北京大学的学生，他说许多学生都反英。这种反英情绪很大程度上源于苏维埃宣传以及某些美国人的秘密活动。

在讨论中国北方最近的战事时，袁表示霍多罗夫曾告诉他，吴佩孚愚弄了美国人，并得到了对他有巨大影响力的英国人的实质性帮助。霍多罗夫还补充说，张作霖得到了日本人的帮助，且他的办公室里有记录证明，一些退役的日本军官正在指挥作战。霍多罗夫进一步表示，他和许多其他人认为，最近的战斗是

ANARCHISM AND COMMUNISM IN CHINA.

An important member of the Chinese Anarchists is a
certain W. S. LEE who is one of the personal friends of the
late SHI FU and is well acquainted with some of the modern
leaders. W.S.Lee stated that a new Anarchist Society had re-
cently been formed in Shanghai having the name "Anarchist
Association", and a book had recently been printed by the
Association but had not yet been circulated.

W. S. Lee seems to be a bitter enemy of Chen Du Hsu
who he says is undoubtedly an agent of Soviet Russia and has
close connection with the Bolshevik Bureau at Irkutsk. Accord-
ing to W.S.Lee Chen Du Hau in 1920 received a sum of $16,000
through a Bolshevik agent called VIJINSKY, and last year he
was given 28,000 by Iodoroff. Chen Du Hsu is described as
being a thoroughly immoral person who keeps a number of concu-
bines and is constantly running after the girls in the Labour
School. Owing to the free way in which he spends his money
Chen Du Hsu collected round him a number of young men some of
whom are regularly paid by him. T. P. CHIKU of the Commercial
Press is one of his chief men, and C. Z. CHANG the labour leader
is kept in touch with Communist propaganda by him. It is further
stated that Chen Du Hsu first got into touch with Bolshevik -
agents through a certain Mr. PANVEY?, a prominent Russian who
used to reside in Peking. Panvey is said to speak Chinese, -
English and Japanese and to be the agent of the Third Interna-
tional. Chen Du Hsu practically controls the sending of Chinese
to Russia and no one is admitted to that country without his
recommendation. His principal delegate to the recent Far East-
ern Conference was a man called CHANG who is a student at the
Peking University. According to W.S.Lee Chen Du Hsu's unpopu-
larity is increasing and the day must soon come when he will be
exposed to the public in his true colours.

中国无政府主义者中的一名重要成员是李某（W. S. LEE，音译），他是已故师复（SHI FU）的私人朋友之一，并与一些现代领导人熟识。李某表示，上海最近成立了一个新的无政府主义团体，名为“无政府主义协会”，该协会最近印刷了一本书籍，但尚未发行。

李某似乎是陈独秀（Chen Du Hsu）的死敌，他说陈独秀无疑是苏俄的代理人，并与伊尔库茨克的布尔什维克局有着密切联系。据李某称，陈独秀于1920年通过一名叫维经斯基（VIJINSKY）的布尔什维克代理人收到了一笔16,000美元的款项，去年他又从霍多罗夫（Iodoroff）那里获得了28,000美元。陈独秀被描述为一个极其不道德的人，蓄有多名妾室，并经常追逐劳工学校的女生。由于他花钱大手大脚，陈独秀身边聚集了一批年轻人，其中一些人定期领取他的薪金。商务印书馆的吉竹（T. P. CHIKU，音译）是他的主要手下之一，而劳工领袖张赤（C. Z. CHANG，音译）则通过他与共产主义宣传保持联系。此外还有说法称，陈独秀最初是通过一位叫潘韦伊先生（Mr. PANVEY?，原文不清）的知名俄罗斯人接触到布尔什维克代理人的，此人曾居住在北京。据说潘韦伊通晓中文、英文和日文，是第三国际的代理人。陈独秀实际上控制着向俄罗斯派遣中国人的事务，没有他的推荐，任何人都不被允许进入该国。他出席最近远东会议的主要代表是一名姓张的学生，就读于北京大学。据李某称，陈独秀的不受欢迎程度日益增加，他真面目被公之于众的日子很快就会到来。
